title: storm-catalogue-topology: code and derived data for a preregistered test of topological storm features and satellite-catalogue degradation
description: Analysis code, public input snapshots and derived data for 'Topological storm features do not predict satellite-catalogue degradation: a preregistered machine-learning test across 206 geomagnetic storms'. The code builds storm catalogues from WDC Kyoto Dst, derives daily catalogue-custody targets from public Space-Track general-perturbations element sets (not redistributed), computes persistent-homology (Betti-curve) features of storm Dst time series, and runs the two preregistered analyses (Registration 1: doi:10.5281/zenodo.24421887; Registration 3: doi:10.5281/zenodo.24423000). Written with the assistance of Claude Code (Anthropic).
